Becca Bloom's "Plate my cats breakfast with me" TikTok

Becca Bloom is a 27-year old TikTok influencer with 6.2 million followers, known for her lavish lifestyle. She grew up in Atherton, California, and is the daughter of Simon Ma and Heidi Chou, co-founders of a billion dollar IT service company. After earning a degree in Business Economics from USC, Bloom began posting TikToks in 2025, becoming associated with a subculture called “RichTok,” which features wealthy influencers. Her videos feature expensive shopping hauls, high-end jewelry, elaborate meals, lavish day plans and relationship or financial advice. Despite the extravagance of her content, Becca Bloom presents herself through a calm, soft-spoken and humorous persona. She curates experiences that are inaccessible to most viewers as ordinary parts of her daily life, creating an interesting contrast that intrigues her audience. This is evident in her TikTok “Plate my cats breakfast with me,” in which she plates an elaborate meal for her cat.
"Little tour of our vintage atelier above our Sag Harbor store. ✨"

Rebecca Hessel Cohen built LoveShackFancy simply from a wedding dress she designed for herself in 2013, and somehow that single rose-colored ruffled piece grew into a company with two dozen boutiques and a $360M net worth- this kind of backstory makes “girl” read less like a visual identity and more like a business strategy. What the brand sells isn't really distinct from how Rebecca lives; her house, her closet, even her daughter’s bat mitzvah all get staged within the same “pink, romantic, girly” world her clothes are designed around, to the point where it's hard to tell if she's showing her life or restaging her storefront. That’s part of why her audience splits so unevenly… the fashion and weddings crowd she's technically selling to is only one piece of it, while a much bigger and messier group watches specifically to decide whether any of this is aspirational or just excessive.
